title: AlphaGo获胜 (AI的斯普特尼克时刻)

summary.text: 2016年3月，Google DeepMind开发的围棋AI AlphaGo在韩国首尔迎战世界顶级棋手李世石（Lee Sedol）。在此之前，围棋因其几乎无穷无尽的变化可能性（比宇宙中的原子数量还多），被认为是人工智能无法攻克的“圣杯”。然而，AlphaGo最终以4:1的总比分取得了压倒性胜利。这场比赛不仅震惊了围棋界，更在东亚乃至全球范围内引发了对AI能力的重新评估。其中第二局的第37手（Move 37）被视为AI展现出“机器直觉”和创造力的标志性时刻，彻底打破了人们认为“电脑只会死算”的刻板印象。
summary.text_en: In March 2016, AlphaGo, a Go AI developed by Google DeepMind, took on world-class player Lee Sedol in Seoul, South Korea. Prior to this, Go was considered the 'Holy Grail' of AI due to its virtually infinite branching possibilities (more than the number of atoms in the universe). However, AlphaGo secured a crushing 4-1 victory. This match not only shocked the Go world but triggered a global reassessment of AI capabilities, especially in East Asia. Move 37 in Game 2 is regarded as the iconic moment where AI demonstrated 'machine intuition' and creativity, shattering the stereotype that 'computers can only calculate'.
key_points: 以4:1击败拥有18个世界冠军头衔的李世石
核心技术：蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) + 策略网络 (Policy Net) + 价值网络 (Value Net)
著名的第37手 (Move 37) 展现了超越人类定式的创造力
李世石在第四局凭借“神之一手” (Move 78) 赢得了人类唯一的一场胜利
不仅是计算力的胜利，更是强化学习（Reinforcement Learning）的胜利
key_points_en: Core Tech: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) + Policy Network + Value Network
Famous Move 37 demonstrated creativity beyond human conventions
Lee Sedol won the only game for humanity in Game 4 with his 'God's Move' (Move 78)
A victory not just of compute, but of Reinforcement Learning

story.text: 赛前，绝大多数围棋专家预测李世石会以5:0或是4:1轻松获胜，因为就在5个月前，AlphaGo才刚刚击败欧洲冠军樊麾（樊麾的水平远低于李世石）。然而比赛一开始，AlphaGo表现出的冷静和对大局的掌控让李世石倍感压力。最著名的时刻发生在第二局：AlphaGo下出了第37手——一步在人类看来几乎是“低级失误”的五路肩冲。解说员惊呼“这是鼠标滑标了吗？”，但随后的进程证明，这是一步甚至超越了职业棋手理解范畴的绝妙好棋。李世石直到第四局才抓住了AlphaGo的一个bug（著名的78手“挖”），赢回了人类的尊严。赛后，李世石感叹：“即使我再赢，也无法抵消输掉比赛的无力感。”
story.text_en: Before the match, most Go experts predicted Lee Sedol would win easily (5-0 or 4-1), as AlphaGo had only beaten European champion Fan Hui (a much weaker player) 5 months prior. But from the start, AlphaGo's calm and board control pressured Lee Sedol immensely. The most famous moment was Move 37 in Game 2—a move that looked like a 'novice mistake' (a shoulder hit on the fifth line) to humans. Commentators gasped, 'Did it misclick?', but the game proved it was a stroke of genius beyond professional comprehension. Lee Sedol only managed to exploit a bug in AlphaGo in Game 4 (the famous Move 78 'Wedge') to reclaim some dignity. After the match, Lee lamented, 'Even if I win again, it cannot erase the powerlessness of losing.'

fun_facts.text: 李世石退役的一个主要原因就是AlphaGo。他说：“随着AI的出现，我意识到即使我成为第一，也有一个实体是无法被战胜的。”
fun_facts.text_en: One of the main reasons Lee Sedol retired was AlphaGo. He said, 'With the debut of AI in Go games, I've realized that I'm not at the top even if I become the number one... there is an entity that cannot be defeated.'

fun_facts.text: AlphaGo在下棋时，其实是由DeepMind的科学家黄士杰（Aja Huang）博士充当“人肉臂”代下的。因为他面无表情且甚至不上厕所，被网友戏称为“真正的AlphaGo”。
fun_facts.text_en: AlphaGo's moves were physically played on the board by DeepMind scientist Dr. Aja Huang. Because he remained expressionless and rarely took breaks, netizens jokingly called him the 'Real AlphaGo'.

simple_explanation.text:
以前的下棋AI（如深蓝）是靠“死算”，把所有可能性算一遍。但围棋变化太多，算不完。
AlphaGo像人一样有了“直觉”。它看一眼棋盘（策略网络），大概知道哪几步是好棋；然后再往下算几步（价值网络），判断胜率。
它既有人的直觉，又有机器的计算，所以无敌。
simple_explanation.text_en:
Old chess AI (like Deep Blue) relied on 'brute force calculation', checking every possibility. But Go has too many variations to calculate.
AlphaGo developed 'intuition' like a human. It glances at the board (Policy Network) to narrow down good moves, then calculates a few steps ahead (Value Network) to judge win rates.
It combined human intuition with machine calculation, becoming invincible.

applications.title: AlphaFold
applications.text: DeepMind后来将AlphaGo的算法思想迁移到了生物学，开发了AlphaFold，成功预测了蛋白质的三维结构，解开了生物学50年的谜题。
applications.text_en: DeepMind later migrated AlphaGo's algorithmic philosophy to biology, creating AlphaFold, which successfully predicted protein 3D structures, solving a 50-year-old biological puzzle.

applications.title: 数据中心节能
applications.text: DeepMind用类似的强化学习算法来控制Google数据中心的冷却系统，将能源消耗降低了40%。
applications.text_en: DeepMind used similar reinforcement learning algorithms to control cooling in Google data centers, reducing energy consumption by 40%.

impact.text: AlphaGo的影响力超出了科技界，成为了一个社会事件。它让东方世界（中日韩）深受震撼，直接触发了各国政府对AI战略的紧急布局（这一刻被称为AI的“斯普特尼克时刻”）。在技术上，它证明了强化学习（RL）结合深度学习（DL）可以解决极度复杂的决策问题，为后来的自动驾驶和机器人控制指明了方向。
impact.text_en: AlphaGo's impact transcended tech, becoming a social phenomenon. It shocked the Eastern world (China, Japan, Korea), directly triggering urgent national AI strategies (known as AI's 'Sputnik Moment'). Technically, it proved that Reinforcement Learning (RL) combined with Deep Learning (DL) could solve extremely complex decision-making problems, guiding the future of autonomous driving and robotics.

influenced_by.contribution: 卷积神经网络（AlphaGo把棋盘看作一张19x19的图片，用CNN来分析局势）
influenced_by.contribution_en: CNN (AlphaGo treated the board as a 19x19 image, using CNNs to analyze the position)

influenced_by.contribution: CUDA（AlphaGo依然依赖大量GPU和TPU进行蒙特卡洛树搜索的并行计算）
influenced_by.contribution_en: CUDA (AlphaGo relied heavily on GPUs and TPUs for parallel computation in Monte Carlo Tree Search)

influenced.contribution: 强化学习的应用（后来的ChatGPT使用的RLHF技术，其核心思想深受AlphaGo强化学习策略的启发）
influenced.contribution_en: RL Applications (The RLHF tech used in ChatGPT was deeply inspired by the reinforcement learning strategies refined in AlphaGo)

influence_chain.legacy_text: 在这一天，人类发现自己不再是地球上最聪明的思考者。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: On this day, humans realized they were no longer the smartest thinkers on Earth.

quiz.question: AlphaGo在第二局中下的“第37手”为什么被认为是里程碑式的？
quiz.question_en: Why is 'Move 37' in Game 2 considered a milestone?
options: 因为它是一步明显的臭棋，但AlphaGo最后还是赢了
因为它打破了人类几千年的定式，不仅从未被人类下过，甚至在当时的棋理看来是错误的
因为它是导致李世石投降的一步棋
因为它是系统故障导致的一步随机棋
options_en: Because it was an obvious blunder, but AlphaGo won anyway
Because it broke thousands of years of convention, was never played by humans, and looked 'wrong' by human theory
Because it was the move that forced Lee Sedol to resign immediately
Because it was a random move caused by a system glitch
quiz.explanation: 第37手是“五路肩冲”。在人类围棋理论中，这是“把胜利拱手让人”的坏棋（因为它让对手在四路围实地）。但AlphaGo计算出这步棋能获得巨大的全局影响力（厚势）。这证明AI不再只是模仿人类，而是创造了新的知识。
quiz.explanation_en: Move 37 was a 'shoulder hit on the fifth line'. In human theory, this is a bad move giving territory to the opponent. But AlphaGo calculated that it provided immense global influence. It proved AI was no longer just mimicking humans but creating new knowledge.
